feeds.title: Sam Shah
feeds.description: Sam Shah is a high school math teacher in Brooklyn who shares reflections, classroom ideas, and math projects on his blog to make learning mathematics engaging and meaningful.

feeds.title: Math = Love
feeds.description: Math = Love is a blog run by Sarah Carter, a high school math teacher from Oklahoma. She creates hands-on math activities, logic puzzles, and classroom resources designed to make math engaging and accessible to students and fellow teachers.

feeds.title: Rise Over Run Blog
feeds.description: Rachael is a lifelong math enthusiast who loves helping students and teachers discover a love for math. She has a master's degree in mathematics education from the University of Missouri. She has served as a math tutor for K-12, a math teacher, and a math coach, and she presents at math conferences.

feeds.title: Teaching High School Math
feeds.description: Teaching High School Math is a blog offering classroom tips, teaching ideas, and resources for high school mathematics educators. The blog features creative activities like logic puzzles, mystery mosaics, and brain breaks to enhance student engagement.

feeds.title: Sophie Does Math
feeds.description: Sophie Does Math is a blog by Sophie, a university student training to become a secondary school teacher. She shares her adventures in math, including reflections, stories, analyses, and lessons learned. The blog promotes a growth mindset for learning math, and Sophie writes about her journey through university and her passion for mathematics.

feeds.title: MathsClass
feeds.description: MathsClass is a blog written by Simon Job, a mathematics teacher from Western Sydney. It focuses on teaching and learning mathematics in the classroom, sharing reflections on curricula, syllabus changes, and practical resources. The site is part of the MathsLinks network and also connects to related projects like MathKit to support teachers and learners.

feeds.title: The Math Guru Blog
feeds.description: Find invigorating insights, Math tips, lesson hacks, practices, and learning motivation in these weekly blog posts. The Math Guru is an online math-learning portal founded in 2010 by Vanessa Vakharia, a certified high school math teacher with a Master's in Mathematics Education.
